name: Tsui no Yakata ~Ningyou~
source:
Released under the Circus brand division 'Circus Fetish', the Tsui no Yakata series mainly focuses on maids.

It's a winter's day and a second-hand dealer by the name of Akihiro pursues a clue he hopes will help him find a valuable doll by the little-known but skillful doll-maker Holst.
The clue leads him to a certain European-style mansion, currently used as a brothel. Akihiro, meeting the mansion's mistress and the maid Melissa, decides to search the house in order to find the missing doll...
translation:
《终之馆》系列由CIRCUS旗下品牌分部“CIRCUS Fetish”发行，主要围绕女仆展开。

一个冬日，名叫明宏的二手商循着一条线索展开调查，希望找到鲜为人知却技艺精湛的人偶师霍尔斯特制作的一尊珍贵人偶。

线索把他带到一座欧式宅邸，如今那里被用作妓院。明宏见到宅邸的女主人和女仆梅丽莎后，决定搜查整栋房子，寻找失踪的人偶……
